tool_args.rationale: All six rows are already at the target horizon. The unresolved question is whether a second sink activates in the joint high-input, high-gradient regime, which the paid rows do not cover. With no dedicated high-gradient probe on the menu, the trajectory batch is the remaining informative acquisition.

The largest measured gradient is 2.20, below the recalled onset range of 2.50–2.68. The onset and strength cannot be estimated from these rows.
